response.query: What annotation schema fields, slot-value definitions, inter-annotator agreement targets (e.g., Fleiss kappa >0.6) and per-item cost estimates are standard for multimodal rumor datasets?
response.answer: Standard multimodal rumor datasets use multi-label annotation schemas, Fleiss kappa >0.6 for inter-annotator agreement, and cost estimates per item based on complexity and required annotations.
